records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: City, Port or Village
records.english: A settlement's size determines which commands are available. Cities are large settlements; ports are smaller ones. Villages allow resupply, but you cannot go ashore. An event may turn a village into a port.
records.context: Original market/shared-command/city-data help and its linked neighbors.
records.source_meaning: Settlement scale affects commands. Cities are large, ports small; villages permit supplies but not landing, and may become ports through events.
records.localization_note: Retain the resupply/landing distinction and the possibility of conversion by an event.
records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
都市／港（街データ）
街の規模を表します。街の規模によって、実行できるコマンドが異なります。
［都市］規模の大きな街です。
［港］規模の小さな街です。
［村］上陸はできず補給だけできる場所です。
イベントで港に変わることもあります。

航路図で、訪れたことのある街を選ぶと表示されます。

文化圏（街データ）
街が所属する文化圏です。文化圏ごとに交易品の価格が異なります。
建物の看板（実行できるコマンド）も変化します。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Cultural Region
records.english: Each city belongs to a cultural region. Trade-good prices vary by region, as do the building signs and available commands.
records.context: Original market/shared-command/city-data help and its linked neighbors.
records.source_meaning: Cultural affiliation affects commodity prices and building signs/available commands.
records.localization_note: Do not reduce the article to generic trade advice or equate culture with national ownership.

状態（街データ）
街の状態によって、物価が上下します。
［通常］普通の状態です。
［戦争］武器は上がり、他は下がります。
［疫病］食料・薬が上がり、他は下がります。［飢饉］食料が上がり、他は下がります。
［好景気］全体的に上がります。
［不景気］全体的に下がります。
［品不足］不足している種類が上がります。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Status
records.english: A city's status affects prices. Normal: ordinary conditions. War: weapon prices rise; other prices fall. Plague: food and medicine prices rise; other prices fall. Famine: food prices rise; other prices fall. Boom: prices rise overall. Slump: prices fall overall. Shortage: prices rise for goods in the category that is in short supply.
records.context: Original market/shared-command/city-data help and its linked neighbors.
records.source_meaning: Seven city conditions and their exact price directions: normal; war/weapons; plague/food and medicine; famine/food; prosperity/all; recession/all; category shortage.
records.localization_note: Use Boom/Slump as idiomatic economic labels. Keep every price direction and affected category; active ARM9 status labels are a separate unfinished localization gate.

発展度（街データ）
街が発展している度合いを表します。
交易所で「[[23|商業投資]]」をすると上がります。
高くなると、街の特産品が増えることがあります。
また、集められる水夫の数や、装備できる大砲の種類も変化します。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Arms
records.english: Arms measures how well a city is armed. It rises when you make [[37|military investments]] at the Palace or Governor's Office. Higher Arms makes a city less likely to surrender when attacked.
records.context: Original market/shared-command/city-data help and its linked neighbors.
records.source_meaning: City armament rises through military investment at palace/government; higher armament lowers likelihood of surrender under attack.
records.localization_note: Match the existing Arms field and retain less likely, without promising immunity to attack.

武装度（街データ）
街の武装度を表します。
王宮・総督府で「[[37|軍事投資]]」をすると上がります。高いほど、攻撃されたときに降伏しにくくなります。

clean_neighbors.source:

シェア（街データ）
特産品入荷量の何％を購入可能かを示します。売却は１％のシェアで、無制限に行えます。
シェアは[[23|商業投資]]・[[37|軍事投資]]・[[38|紹介状]]・[[39|推薦状]]で上げられます。ただし、最初の１％は王宮・総督府の[[36|契約]]で得る必要があります。
勢力の本拠地では、[[183|本拠地ポイント]]分のシェアがプラスされます。
→[[151|独占契約]]

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Market Share
records.english: Your market share determines how much of a city's specialty stock you can buy. A 1 percent share lets you sell without a limit. Increase your share through [[23|commercial investment]], [[37|military investment]], [[38|letters of introduction]] or [[39|letters of recommendation]]. You must obtain the first 1 percent through a [[36|contract]] at the Palace or Governor's Office. At your faction's home port, [[183|Home Port Points]] add to its share. See [[151|Exclusive Contracts]].
records.context: Original market/shared-command/city-data help and its linked neighbors.
records.source_meaning: Share determines purchasable proportion of specialty arrivals.1 percent permits unlimited selling. Four means of increasing share; first1 percent requires contract. Home-base points add home-city share. Link to monopoly.
records.localization_note: Retain both the initial-contract rule and later letter/investment methods, plus the home-port bonus. Do not shorten the article to fit one page.

独占契約（街データ→シェア）
街のシェアを 100％得ると「独占契約」となり街を自勢力の支配下におけます。上納金を毎月得られるほか、交戦中の勢力に攻撃をしかけてもらえます。
他の勢力が独占契約中の街とは、通常の方法で契約できません。契約するには[[38|紹介状]]・[[39|推薦状]]を使うか、独占契約中の勢力と交戦する必要があります。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Exclusive Contracts
records.english: A 100 percent market share gives your faction an exclusive contract and control of the city. You receive tribute each month and can have the city attack factions you are at war with. You cannot obtain a contract by the usual method in a city controlled by another faction's exclusive contract. Use [[38|a letter of introduction]] or [[39|a letter of recommendation]], or go to war with that faction.
records.context: Original market/shared-command/city-data help and its linked neighbors.
records.source_meaning: 100 percent share grants monopoly/control, monthly tribute and attacks against warring factions. Ordinary contracting is unavailable under another monopoly; letters or war provide alternatives.
records.localization_note: Preserve all benefits and all three alternatives without inventing a guaranteed automatic contract from declaring war.

特産品（街データ）
街で売却している交易品です。
街の発展度が高くなったり、原産物が持ち込まれると増えることがあります。
特産品は[[24|入荷月]]がくるたびに補充されます。
→[[194|原産物]]

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Source Items
records.english: Source items can create new specialties in a city. Bring one to the market, and the city may gain a new specialty. This will not work if the city is unsuitable for the item or already has five specialties. Several cities can suit the same item. Consider giving it to a convenient city, such as one where your faction has a high [[150|market share]].
records.context: Original market/shared-command/city-data help and its linked neighbors.
records.source_meaning: Source items may expand specialties at suitable markets; no increase if unsuitable or already five products. Several cities may suit an item; high own share is a useful criterion.
records.localization_note: Keep the suitability and five-specialty limits; do not confuse these specialty-producing items with ordinary raw-material trade goods.
records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
原産物
特産品の元となるアイテムです。
これを持って交易所に行くと、その街の特産品が増えることがあります。
原産物の特性に合わない街や、すでに特産品が５つある街では増えません。
【！】特性に合う街はいくつかあります。自勢力の[[150|シェア]]が高い街など都合のいい街で原産物を譲るとよいでしょう。

clean_neighbors.source:
等級（交易品データ）
交易品には１から５級までの等級があります。１級が最高です。
街の[[148|発展度]]が上がると、その街の[[152|特産品]]の等級も上がります。
【！】等級の高い交易品ほど高級です。高級な品を売買するほど、儲けが大きくなります。

船データ
各船のデータです。
情報コマンドの「船情報」で船を選ぶと表示されます。
→[[196|耐久力]]　→[[197|水夫数]]　→[[198|水・食料]]
→[[199|横帆性能]]　→[[200|縦帆性能]]
